Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with searchable CC player rankings and prediction, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Bigger incoming arrows with a Den-friendly preview. Optional official tiers from daily saved Lodestone standings; unlisted players stay Unknown. Separate English Opponents/Teammates win-loss lists. Dedicated LB preview and independent live bars. Healing-pot clipping and German Guardian chat syntax corrected; live detection and chat delivery still need confirmation.
